item.title: Len Howard Conservation Park
item.description:
While driving to Halls Head near Mandurah to pick up something I had bought on marketplace, I decided to bring my camera and 150-600mm to see if I could capture any interesting coastal birds top make the drive down a bit more worth the effort.

After picking up my item from a very friendly older guy I did a quick google and found the Len Howard Conservation Park, complete with bird hide, just five minutes away. After leaving my car on the side of the road (I didn’t see the carpark 200m down the road) I wandered into the small area of bushland and found the hide, and also a Quenda digging on the side of the path.

item.title: Birds in the park
item.description:
I hadn’t been to Jorgensen Park since we moved out of the Spring Road house and Athena was in Witchcliffe. But now that I am living in High Wycombe and Athena is with us, I have started taking her back there for walks.

I noticed that some of the smaller birds had begun showing their colourful mating plumage so I brought my camera up a few times and got a few ok shots while walking.

item.title: My new site
item.description:
Welcome to my new site, this is my first post that I am making while I create this space. I have just figured out basic functionality for blog posts and photography posts.

I decided to host on github for the ease of version controlling and deploying being combined out of the box and having an existing account with various other projects.

I then turned to the Hugo static site generator to manage content creation and smooth over writing the most tedious and repetitive HTML tasks. After figuring out how to translate my mediocre CSS knowledge into Hugo’s theme system and learning about how great partials are I feel like I made some quick progress.
